note: Codes are part of the public contract; message copy is not. Match on codes.

codes.meaning: Authentication failed. No degraded mode serves data without a verified identity.
Authenticated, but the scope or tenant does not permit this action.
Request failed validation; the response names the offending field.
No such resource within the caller's tenant scope.
Duplicate under idempotency; the original record stays authoritative.
Too many requests. Back off and retry; writes are idempotent.
Unhandled server error. Retry with backoff and quote the request id.
